title: Priority Admission to Co-located Primary Schools for Students in MOE Kindergartens
what_it_is: Priority Admission to Co-located Primary Schools for Students in MOE Kindergartens

sections.label: MK children primary school transition
sections.summary: MOE introduced Phase 2A2 eligibility for MK children as a pilot and will increase MKs to 50 by 2023.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ng Chee Meng
sentences.text: Hence, MOE has assessed that it is timely to facilitate a smoother transition of MK children to the primary school that the MK is located within.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ng Chee Meng
sentences.text: This is why we introduced the Phase 2A2 eligibility for MK children as a pilot scheme.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ng Chee Meng
sentences.text: This means that MK children will be eligible to register under Phase 2A2 for admission to the primary school that the MK is located within, during the Primary 1 school Registration Exercise, like other Phase 2A2 eligible children, under the same procedures and rules of the Primary 1 Registration Framework.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ng Chee Meng
sentences.text: To serve a larger proportion of Singaporean children, MOE will increase the number of MKs to 50 by 2023.

sections.label: Phase 2A2 admission eligibility calibration
sections.summary: Admission eligibility was calibrated at Phase 2A2, below Phase 1 and Phase 2A1.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ng Chee Meng
sentences.text: We are mindful of this and have put in place measures to mitigate it.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ng Chee Meng
sentences.text: We have deliberately calibrated the admission eligibility to be at Phase 2A2, which is below that for younger siblings of students already in the school, which is Phase 1 and children of alumni members in Phase 2A1.

sections.label: MK places reserved lower-income children
sections.summary: One-third of MK places are reserved for Singaporean children from households earning $3,500 and below within one kilometre.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ng Chee Meng
sentences.text: Some preschool operators have expressed concerns that the admission eligibility for MK children would make their preschools less attractive.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ng Chee Meng
sentences.text: But given the growing demand for preschool services, the Government's foremost objective is to ensure that parents have access to quality and affordable preschools for their children, and MKs are part of this strategy, with one-third of MK places reserved for Singaporean children from households with a gross monthly income of $3,500 and below, living within one kilometre of the MK.

sections.label: MKs expanded to 50
sections.summary: The MKs are going to be expanded to 50.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ng Chee Meng
sentences.text: The MKs are going to be expanded to 50.

sections.label: 50 MKs market share
sections.summary: Even with 50 MKs completed, it will be only 20% of the market.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ng Chee Meng
sentences.text: Having said that, in totality, as I have said earlier, even when we are finished with the 50 MKs, it will be only 20% of the market.

sections.label: Reserved MK slots lower-income families
sections.summary: Children from lower-income families have a reserved one-third of any MK slots.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ng Chee Meng
sentences.text: Children who are from lower-income families have a reserved one-third of any MK slots.

sections.label: 50 MKs by 2023
sections.summary: Realising the 50 MKs will take up to 2023, and if demand exceeds supply, a fair and transparent balloting system will take place.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ng Chee Meng
sentences.text: On the second question, it will take us up to 2023 to realise the 50 MKs.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ng Chee Meng
sentences.text: Should there be greater demand than supply, a fair and transparent balloting system will take place.
